purpose: Teach: 客席/エンディング/上回っ/見逃し/ミネラル/延々と/深める/と同時に

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コンサートの、本気で、絶対、客席、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、よく見えたわ
lines.en: Aoi, I could see everything from the audience seats at that concert so clearly.
lines.style: Warm, bright opening. A beat of genuine delight. Leans forward slightly. Natural, conversational cadence—like she's sharing something she'd been thinking about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、好きな映画の、絶対、エンディング、絶対、感動したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. And I was really moved by the ending of that movie you love—genuinely moved.
lines.style: Animated and present. Quick, engaged tempo. A small laugh threaded through. She's mirroring Mei's warmth and building on it naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の売上、本気で、絶対、目標を、絶対、上回った、絶対、ね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your shop's sales actually exceeded the target—I have to say, I'm impressed.
lines.style: Warm admiration in the voice. Clear and direct, but tender underneath. Slight pause before the praise lands. She means it completely.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の好みを、絶対、見逃した、絶対、こと、絶対、絶対、避けたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really want to make sure I never miss what our customers actually prefer—that matters too much.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly vulnerable. Thoughtful pace. She's being honest about something that weighs on her. No performance, just care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ミネラル、絶対、ウォーター、絶対、お客様、絶対、人気でしょ?メイちゃん
lines.en: The mineral water is becoming quite popular with customers, isn't it?
lines.style: Curious and warm. A light lift at the end—genuine question, not rhetorical. She's noticing something real about the business.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、延々と、絶対、お料理の研究、絶対、続けてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I keep researching recipes endlessly—it's become this ongoing thing for me.
lines.style: Earnest and a touch self-aware. Steady rhythm. A hint of vulnerability—admitting this is something she can't quite stop doing. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、知識、絶対、深める、絶対、姿勢、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、感心するわ
lines.en: Your commitment to deepening your knowledge about cooking—that's really something I admire about you.
lines.style: Tender praise. Slow, deliberate delivery. Each phrase carries weight. She's speaking to something real she sees in Aoi. Genuine and unguarded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: と同時に、葵、本気で、絶対、新店舗、絶対、と、絶対、同時に、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、発表したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And at the same time, you announced a whole new menu alongside opening the new location.
lines.style: Animated close. Building energy and appreciation. Quick tempo, bright tone. A sense of momentum and excitement about what Aoi has accomplished.
